content.title: FAQ | How to Watch the Braves | Atlanta Braves
content.text: BravesVisionWhat is BravesVision?BravesVision is your new home for Atlanta Braves baseball for the 2026 season! BravesVision will produce more than 140 games, as well as extensive pre-game and post-game programming throughout the 2026 regular season for fans across the Braves six state territory.Will BravesVision broadcast all Braves games in the local market, as was previously done with FanDuel Sports Network South and FanDuel Sports Network Southeast?Yes. Locally distributed Braves games are produced and distributed under the name BravesVision for the 2026 season. The Braves will oversee production, sales, marketing, and distribution of local television broadcasts.Where can I find BravesVision on my cable, satellite or streaming service provider?BravesVision is available on numerous cable, satellite, and streaming services, including: Xfinity (channel 1254) DIRECTV (channel 645) Spectrum Fubo U-Verse (channel 1730) and multiple providers throughout Braves Country. The full lineup can be found here: Will my cable, satellite or streaming provider carry BravesVision?The Braves have partnered with cable, satellite, and streaming services to provide BravesVision to their customers, including Xfinity, DIRECTV, Spectrum, Fubo and U-Verse.YouTube TV has indicated they will not carry BravesVision, so the best option for YouTube TV customers in the Braves television market is to purchase a Braves.TV streaming package.For more information on BravesVision, contact your cable, satellite or streaming service provider.Braves.TVWill I be able to stream Braves games in the Braves television market?Yes! BravesVision telecasts are available on Braves.TV, a new streaming platform from Major League Baseball. With a subscription, all regular season non-national exclusive Braves games will be available to fans everywhere within the Braves television market with NO BLACKOUTS!How much does Braves.TV cost?A season subscription to Braves.TV, featuring live and on-demand streaming on over 140 regular season Braves games with no local blackouts is available for $99.99. A monthly subscription is available for $19.99 and comes with a seven-day free trial.Is there a Braves.TV or BravesVision app? I can’t find it in my app store.Braves.TV is a service that streams Braves games airing on BravesVision and is accessible through the MLB app. When you’re in your app store, you’ll need to search for the MLB app, not Braves.TV.Which devices will I be able to access Braves.TV from?Fans can stream Braves.TV on a variety of devices through the MLB app. You can find the full list of devices here: I live within the Braves television market - are there any blackouts on Braves.TV?No local blackouts! In-market Braves.TV subscribers can stream ALL local Braves broadcasts on BravesVision with no blackouts. The only time a Braves game won’t be available to stream in-market on Braves.TV is when a national broadcaster is broadcasting the game.Braves Games on Braves.TV Blackout TrackerSUBSCRIBER LIVES IN BRAVES HOME TELEVISION TERRITORYSubscriber LocationBraves OpponentCan the Subscriber Watch?Subscriber is in the Braves home television territoryBraves are playing against any opponentYesSubscriber is in Miami visiting friendsBraves playing the NationalsYes, because Braves.TV offers travel rightsSubscriber is in Miami visiting friendsBraves playing the MarlinsNo, because the local Marlins broadcast takes precedence because the fan is in MiamiSubscriber is in the Braves home television territoryBraves are playing on national exclusive gameNo, because the national exclusive blackout takes precedenceHow do I stream Braves games if I live outside of the local area?Fans who live outside of the Braves television market can subscribe to Braves.TV/Atlanta Braves MLB.TV Single Team package to stream Braves games via the MLB app outside of the local area. When the Braves play against the designated MLB team in your local area, the game will be blacked out on MLB.TV.Braves Games on Braves.TV Blackout TrackerSUBSCRIBER LIVES OUTSIDE BRAVES HOME TELEVISION TERRITORYSubscriber LocationSubscriber Streaming ProductBraves OpponentCan the Subscriber Watch?Subscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryBraves.TV (MLB.TV Single Team Package for the Atlanta Braves)Braves are playing against any opponent that is NOT assigned to the subscriber’s home television territoryYesSubscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryMLB.TVBraves are playing against any opponent that is NOT assigned to the subscriber’s home television territoryYesSubscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryBraves.TV (MLB.TV Single Team Package for the Atlanta Braves)Braves are playing against an opponent assigned to the subscriber’s home television territoryNo, because the local team’s broadcast takes precedence because the fan is in that team’s local marketSubscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryMLB.TVBraves are playing against an opponent assigned to the subscriber’s home television territoryNo, because MLB.TV is only for out of market games, and the local team’s broadcast takes precedence because the fan is in that team’s local marketSubscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryMLB.TV/Club.TV BundleBraves are playing against an opponent assigned to the subscriber’s home television territoryYes, because with the individual having subscribed to the MLB.TV/Club.TV bundle, the Braves won’t be blacked out because Club.TV features no local blackoutsSubscriber lives in another MLB team’s home television territoryBraves are playing on national exclusive gameBraves are playing against any opponentNo, because the national exclusive blackout takes precedenceI live in either the Mets, Phillies, Nationals or Marlins home television area. Does that mean Braves games vs. each of these NL East teams will be blacked out for me if I purchase Braves.TV/Atlanta Braves MLB.TV Single Team package? That’s up to 13 games I’d miss.Yes – however, in order to guarantee no blackouts (unless a game is broadcast by a national broadcaster), you would need to purchase the MLB.TV/Club.TV bundle for $199.99/season or $39.99/month. So, if you live in the Nationals home television area, you’d need to purchase the MLB.TV/Nationals.TV bundle, or if you live in Miami you’d need to purchase the MLB.TV/Marlins.TV bundle.I'm a Braves.TV subscriber who lives in the Braves local territory but I'm traveling out of the Braves market. Can I still watch games on Braves.TV?Braves.TV subscribers who are traveling outside of the Braves home territory can still watch Braves games while traveling and are only subject to the opposing team’s local blackout restrictions, if applicable. So, if you’re visiting Washington, D.C. and the Braves are playing the Marlins, you will be able to watch the game if it’s on BravesVision. However, if you’re visiting Washington, D.C. and the Braves are playing the Nationals, you are subject to a blackout restriction.Can MLB.TV All Teams subscribers watch Braves games on MLB.TV in the Atlanta Braves television market?Only users that have specifically purchased the 2026 Braves.TV package or the Braves.TV/MLB.TV bundle subscription will be able to stream Braves games in the local area. MLB.TV All Teams subscribers will NOT have access and must purchase Braves.TV in order to stream Braves games in the home market.Can I authenticate access to Braves games through the MLB.TV app by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider?Authentication information from your pay-TV provider will be available once distributor deals are finalized.Will I be able to watch Braves games if I have a standard MLB.TV package, but not the Braves.TV package?If you already have the MLB app downloaded, you’re one step closer to watching Braves baseball! Braves fans living within the Braves home television territory must purchase a Braves.TV subscription to stream Braves games. Only fans who live outside the Braves home market will be able to watch Braves games with the standard MLB.TV package. But remember, when the Braves play the team in your home television territory, the game would be blacked out on MLB.TVHow do I know if I live in the Braves home territory?A map of the Atlanta Braves home television territory is below.Additional QuestionsCan I watch Braves.TV through the ESPN app?Currently ESPN only offers the out-of-market MLB.TV service. In 2026, in-market Braves.TV games will be available for streaming in the MLB app and not available in-market on the ESPN app.Will select Braves games still be simulcast on over-the-air stations like they were in 2025?For the second consecutive season, the Braves have partnered with Gray Media to simulcast a select number of regular season games over-the-air (OTA) for free in Atlanta and across the Southeast through Gray’s network of broadcast stations. For a list of Gray Media stations in Braves Country, visit bravesongray.com.
